About

Product quality, from idea to release

I'm a mobile developer who focuses on the details that make an app feel fast and reliable. I work across requirements analysis, system design, and implementation, so the product stays clear while the codebase stays ready to grow.

My background includes NLP and information retrieval from Damascus University, which helps me approach data-heavy features with analytical care. I volunteer as a Flutter developer for women's empowerment programs and supervise software engineering students at Damascus University.
